name: Audio-Visual Saliency for Immersive Movie Viewing
description: A dataset and benchmark suite for predicting audio-visual saliency during movie viewing in immersive environments.
evaluation_method: AUC (AUC-Judd), NSS, CC and KL-divergence are commonly used
notes: Multimodal (audio + visual) saliency dataset for immersive viewing; likely limited dataset size and subject variability, head/eye-tracking noise and ecological validity concerns; non-LLM benchmark.
